([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0007 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to design your Tap to Pay on iPhone button to match the other buttons in your app. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0008 · SHOULD · high** — Present a progress indicator while payment is authorizing before you show your transaction result screen in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0009 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to help merchants complete the checkout flow when a payment can’t complete with Tap to Pay on iPhone. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0010 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to make it easy for merchants to get help with issues they can’t resolve. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0011 · SHOULD · high** — Use a generic action label when reading a payment card without a transaction amount. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0012 · MUST · high** — Show how customers position a contactless card or digital wallet in every custom merchant tutorial. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0013 · SHOULD · high** — Make payment options in addition to Tap to Pay on iPhone, as necessary available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0014 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to respond quickly if a merchant initiates checkout before enabling Tap to Pay on iPhone. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0015 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to help merchants perform checkout even if device configuration is still in progress. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0016 · MAY · high** — Consider external hardware or a payment link after Tap to Pay can’t complete. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0017 · SHOULD · high** — Present tap to Pay on iPhone terms and conditions only to an administrative user in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0018 · SHOULD · high** — Present pre-payment actions that affect the final total before checkout completes in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0019 · MAY · high** — Consider a new or reused checkout screen for cash or another alternate payment. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0020 · SHOULD · high** — Determine the customer’s final payable amount before the merchant starts Tap to Pay. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0021 · SHOULD · high** — Clearly display the result of a transaction, whether it’s declined or successful. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0022 · MUST · high** — Present Tap to Pay terms only after the merchant installs the iOS version required by the PSP. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0023 · MUST · high** — Show how to launch checkout for every supported payment type in a custom merchant tutorial. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0024 · MUST · high** — Show card PIN entry, including accessibility mode, in a custom merchant tutorial. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0025 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to make the Tap to Pay button easy to find among payment methods. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0026 · MUST · high** — Use Tap to Pay on iPhone, or Tap to Pay when space is constrained, as the activation-button label. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0027 · SHOULD · high** — Present pre-payment options before the Tap to Pay screen in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0028 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply immediate transaction processing after a successful tap in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0029 · MAY · high** — Evaluate whether relaunching Tap to Pay when a customer has another card is appropriate for the current context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0030 · SHOULD · high** — Present clear descriptions for merchant-addressable system errors in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0031 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to distinguish independent loyalty-card flows from payment-acceptance flows. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0032 · MUST · high** — Work with a supported payment service provider before integrating Tap to Pay on iPhone. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0033 · MUST · high** — Obtain the Tap to Pay on iPhone entitlement before integration. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0034 · MUST · high** — Use ProximityReader APIs through the PSP SDK or the framework for Tap to Pay integration. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0035 · MUST · high** — Obtain the merchant’s acceptance of the relevant terms before enabling Tap to Pay or configuring the device. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0036 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply proximityReader API to check terms-acceptance status in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0037 · SHOULD · high** — Present the terms-acceptance flow only when necessary in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0038 · SHOULD · high** — Present nonadministrators that administrator access is required in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0039 · SHOULD · high** — Make a terms-acceptance opportunity at the end of the tutorial available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0040 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply an indeterminate indicator for most background configuration in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0041 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply a determinate indicator when ProximityReader reports ongoing configuration in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0042 · AVOID · high** — Exclude requiring merchants to scroll to reach Tap to Pay from the applicable experience. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0043 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply automatic Tap to Pay opening when it is the only payment method in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0044 · MUST · high** — Let merchants choose among configured payment methods during checkout without visiting app settings. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0045 · MAY · high** — Evaluate whether reusing Charge or Checkout when Tap to Pay is the only payment method is appropriate for the current context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0046 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply the Tap to Pay SF Symbol when payment-method buttons use icons in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0047 · MUST_NOT · high** — Never include the Apple logo in a Tap to Pay button. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0048 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply the Tap to Pay on iPhone label only for payment actions in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0049 · MAY · high** — Evaluate whether coordinating Tap to Pay button color and shape with the interface is appropriate for the current context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0050 · MUST · high** — Offer tipping and other total-affecting interactions before presenting the Tap to Pay screen. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0051 · SHOULD · high** — Apply the documented Tap to Pay on iPhone guidance to aim to display the final amount on the Tap to Pay screen. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0052 · SHOULD · high** — Give merchants ways to offer digital receipts wherever practicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0053 · SHOULD · high** — Make appropriate resolutions for merchant-addressable system errors available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0054 · AVOID · high** — Exclude tap to Pay labels for no-amount card-reading actions from the applicable experience. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0055 · SHOULD · high** — Choose or apply a separate clearly labeled button for independent loyalty-card transactions in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-TAP-TO-PAY-ON-IPHONE-0056 · AVOID · high** — Exclude payment-related terms in independent loyalty-transaction labels from the applicable experience. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tap-to-pay-on-iphone))
### voiceover

- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0001 · SHOULD · medium** — Make alternative labels for all key interface elements available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0002 · SHOULD · medium** — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to describe meaningful images. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0003 · SHOULD · medium** — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to make charts and other infographics fully accessible. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0004 · SHOULD · medium** — Choose or apply titles and headings to help people navigate your information hierarchy in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0005 · SHOULD · medium** — Ensure the experience accommodates the VoiceOver rotor when possible. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0006 · SHOULD · medium** — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to be mindful that custom gestures aren’t always accessible. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007 · SHOULD · high** — Specify element grouping, order, and links so VoiceOver communicates relationships that are otherwise visual. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
### wallet

- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0001 · SHOULD · low** — Make to add new passes to Wallet available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))

- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0004 · SHOULD · low** — Preserve people’s ability to jump from your app to their pass in Wallet. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))

- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0007 · SHOULD · low** — Maintain passes up to date. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0008 · SHOULD · low** — Choose or apply change messages only for updates to time-critical information in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0009 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to design a pass that looks great and works well on all devices. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0010 · SHOULD · low** — Maintain the pass front uncluttered. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0011 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to make your pass instantly identifiable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0012 · MUST · medium** — Verify that sufficient contrast between background and text colors. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0013 · SHOULD · low** — Choose or apply language that works on any device in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0014 · SHOULD · low** — Maintain image file sizes small. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0015 · SHOULD · low** — Make a pass icon available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0016 · AVOID · low** — Exclude inner drop shadows on logo artwork from the applicable experience. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0017 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to make it easy for people to add an order to Wallet. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0018 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to make information about an order available immediately after people place it. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0019 · SHOULD · low** — Make fulfillment information as soon as it’s available, and keep the status up to date available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0020 · SHOULD · low** — Choose or apply clear, approachable language, and localize the text you provide in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0021 · SHOULD · low** — Make a link to an area where people manage their order available when applicable. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0022 · AVOID · low** — Exclude sending duplicate notifications from the applicable experience. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0023 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to make it easy for customers to contact the merchant. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0024 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to help people track their order. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0025 · SHOULD · low** — Maintain the fulfillment screen centered on order tracking. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0026 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to choose shipping-fulfillment values that match the details you have about the shipping process. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0027 · SHOULD · low** — Maintain customers informed through relevant fulfillment status descriptions. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0028 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to be direct and thorough when describing an Issue or Canceled status. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0029 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to ask for identity information only at the precise moment you need it. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0030 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to ask only for the data you actually need. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0031 · SHOULD · low** — Apply the documented Wallet guidance to choose the system-provided verification button that matches your use case and the visual design of your app. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0032 · SHOULD · low** — Present a Wallet verification option only when the device supports it in the documented context. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0033 · SHOULD · low** — Reserve pass images for visual content for the documented purpose. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
- **HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0034 · SHOULD · low** — Clearly describe each item so people can verify that their order contains everything they expect. ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/wallet))
